title: Story premise EDU060: The Retrospective Rewinds One Frame
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (work/process). Hook: What happened just before the mistake became expensive? Takeaway/theme: Review a sequence of events and test a specific change instead of guessing motives.
description: A team wants a recurring failure to stop, but a retrospective jumps from the outcome straight to blame. Rewinding a concrete timeline exposes a missing check and yields one testable process adjustment.
